edition: January 1981 official reprint, incorporating amendments approved December 1973 and March 1980
normalization: Already-uppercase modern Russian letters only. Explicit uppercase Latin labels for the table's letter combinations. No source case, whitespace, punctuation, stress or old-letter normalization; outside-domain input is rejected.

hard_sign.meaning: One atomic double-quote marker, not two apostrophes.

marker_representation.note: ASCII labels distinguish the signs shown in the scan; no historical digital encoding or case recovery is claimed.

outside_domain_extension.note: Table 2 row 49; admitting this punctuation gives up to 26 output characters and defeats the restricted 25-symbol support bound.

decoder: Complete codeword DP parsing, all input consumed; preserve distinct quote markers.
